text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A fierce battle on the straight course!! 
Every Umamusume is launching into their 
final spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, so fast...! And man, what kind of 
insane pressure is she puttin' on me...! 
Still, though—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I've got things I can't afford to back 
down on, too...!!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Lucky Lilac! Lucky Lilac is in the 
lead!!! Lucky Lilac--!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Junior Class Queen proves her strength 
once more!! Lucky Lilac brilliantly claims 
the cherry blossoms!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Haa... Haa... ...Alright... 
Alright, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Catch your breath...! Pull yourself 
together...!! I won...!! I actually 
won...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ai-san's running took a huge toll on 
me... and my body feels so heavy right 
now...!! Even so...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
S-So aaaawesome~~~~...!!! Lucky Lilac is a 
total queen...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye was amazing, but Lucky Lilac is 
seriously out of this world...! What an 
unbelievable generation this is...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Lala.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm truly, truly frustrated...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to beat you today, no matter 
what...!! I truly believed I could 
win...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still...! You were the stronger one...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks! ...Let me race against you 
there one more time!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get way, way stronger than I am 
today, and next time for sure... I'm going 
to win!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Ai-san was incredible today, just 
based on her running alone.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(On top of that, this incredible presence 
that makes you certain she'll be even 
stronger next time...! I really can't let 
my guard down. But――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Works for me, Ai-san. We'll settle the 
score at the Oaks, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win next time too.
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. You too, 
Trainer—wait, what—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, were you crying?
choice_data_list:
I was chopping onions just a moment 
ago...!

text_block_list.text:
You couldn't blame me for playing the 
fool. Lucky Lilac had just won a Classic 
race.

As a Trainer, nothing could bring me 
greater joy...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, I'll have to get you to 
chop up even more onions, won't I? After 
all—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I still want more Tiaras, after all.

And so, Lucky Lilac claimed a splendid 
victory in the Oka Sho, capturing her 
first tiara—
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The next Tiara race is the 2,400m turf 
'Oaks'..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The distance increases quite a bit from 
the Oka Sho, so we need to prepare 
thoroughly to keep our winning momentum 
going.
choice_data_list: Yeah, our goal is the Double Tiara!
Yeah, our goal is the Double Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...However—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aside from handling the distance, I reckon 
we gotta have a plan for Ai-san too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"To be completely honest, Ai-san's running 
in the Oka Sho went way beyond my 
expectations...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I genuinely felt that if I had made even a 
single wrong judgment call during the 
race, I would have lost.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Even now, I still tremble when I 
remember it. I was still underestimating 
Ai-san—

Almond Eye's running far surpassed all 
prior predictions. This was entirely my 
oversight.

Her speed, in particular, conceals an 
astounding potential. We'll need to stay 
on high alert for the Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I will never, ever misjudge them again.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave nothing to chance and face 
them head-on. I'll be counting on your 
guidance.
choice_data_list:
Let's go claim it—the glory of the 
Oaks...!

text_block_list.text:
Toward the next decisive battle, the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks). She stays vigilant 
even in victory as she prepares—
